title: Inventory closed before the gate
body: The shell box is signed out at 6:10, the marked route is closed at 5:40, and a spare key is still tied to the map. The return box is blank.
rival_reading: A test crew could have recorded a temporary site closure before retrieving equipment; the blank line does not say who set the schedule.
gloss: A collection record places a route closure before the return of its equipment.

title: The jars stay sealed
body: Keep the pesticide trial jars sealed until the boundary check is done. The neighbor keeps knocking because the map says don't go; the dog is still in the yard.
rival_reading: A response crew could have sealed ordinary pest-control supplies while closing an area; keeping the jars shut does not show the trial malfunctioned.
gloss: A field-trial warning and a household access problem remain on the same note.
